title: (Pwn2Own) Amazon Smart Plug Insecure Fallback Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Amazon Smart Plug. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the distress beaconing process. The issue results from the device falling back to a less secure state. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the device.
